theorem_families.conditions: Specified PR object, arrow, and component families; equality is pointwise arithmetic equality. No internal collection of all PR functors is assumed.

theorem_families.conditions: A fixed presented category, a fixed setoid-valued presheaf, and one specified natural transformation at fixed p,A, with stated laws. The correspondence is schematic unless actual finite tables are enumerated.

theorem_families.conditions: Specified natural transformations and inverse equations, or a chosen universal element with a PR factor operation. No representative choice is inferred from a bare existential.

theorem_families.conditions: Generator equality is defined by equality of values; cocone components are supplied as one fixed uniform PR family with their laws. No arbitrary quotient or colimit existence is asserted.
theorem_families.lean_status: Four new algebraic derivation constructors are uncompiled. Tuple coding, all setoid laws, and the universal cocone record are not implemented by these adapters.
